1. (Currently Amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the bankruptcy documents are proofs of claim forms and supporting documentation specific to bankruptcy proceedings;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and are formatted according to the filing requirements of each respective bankruptcy organization; and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations by electronically transmitting the formatted documents directly to each bankruptcy organization's filing system.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the automatically generating step includes transforming the received data records into court-specific formats required by each different court's filing system.

6. (Currently Amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim that is specific to bankruptcy proceedings and distinct from general credit rating or creditworthiness assessment data;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and are formatted according to the specific filing requirements and forms mandated by each respective bankruptcy organization; and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations by electronically transmitting the formatted proofs of claims directly to each bankruptcy organization's filing system.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the automatically generating step includes transforming the received data records into court-specific proof of claim formats required by each different bankruptcy court's filing system.

8. (Original) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy.

9. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol.

10. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site.

11. (Original) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day.

12. (Original) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report; and
sending the report to a particular creditor.

13. (Original) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site.

14. (Original) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed.

15. (Original) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim.

16. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer.

17. (Original) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record.

18. (Previously Presented) A computer readable medium comprising:
code for receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim;
code for automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and
code for batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations.

19. (Previously Presented) A server comprising the computer readable medium of claim 18.

20. (Previously Presented) A data processing system comprising the server of claim 19.

21. (Previously Presented) The computer readable medium of claim 18 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations.

22. (Previously Presented) The computer readable medium of claim 18 wherein each proof of claim includes a proof of claim form and supporting documentation.

23. (Previously Presented) The computer readable medium of claim 18 wherein the code for receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises code for receiving the data records using a Web site.

24. (Previously Presented) The computer readable medium of claim 18 further comprising code for notifying creditors of bankruptcy filings.

25. (Previously Presented) The computer readable medium of claim 18 further comprising:
code for generating a report; and
code for sending the report.
